summary: polynomial-capacity widget finished and verified. Controls: degree slider 0-15 (capped at N-1), N buttons 10/20/50/200, noise sigma slider 0.05-0.6, New noise draw, Reset, show bias2/variance checkbox; charts also pick a degree on click. Default N=20, sigma=0.3, d=3, seed 0: train RMSE 0.277, val 0.338, bias2 0.0052, variance 0.0161, sum 0.1113 (minimum at d=3). Numbers checked against an independent NumPy/Legendre/lstsq/pinv implementation using identical mulberry32 draws, in 6 states (N20 d3 and d15; N10 s0.05 d9; N50 s0.6 seed1 d3; N200 d5 and d15; N20 s0.6 seed2 d9): train, val, bias2, variance, total and both best degrees all agree to display rounding. Spec table values reproduced: d3 0.0052/0.0161, d9 variance 0.0422, d15 variance 0.8737, N=200 minimum at degree 5 (0.0927).
